_meta.description: The daemonhunter stream (logs-dxdfir.daemonhunter-*): the logs-*-* base + logs-dxdfir@settings + the GoDFIR Linux/macOS daemon-parser fields. Priority 500 — higher than the logs-dxdfir.*-* fallback (200) — so this stream composes only this lane's model(s), not every lane's, and bare field names stay contained to the stream that uses them.
